name: Kingdom Defense
summary:
Kingdom Defense is an action-focused defense game where strategy and reflexes come together inside a colorful fantasy world built for VR.

Your goal is simple but challenging: defend your kingdom against endless waves of enemies. Pirates, monsters, and dangerous creatures attack from multiple directions, forcing you to think fast and adapt your tactics in real time.
